t: Introduction and overview — Blue Ridge-class Command Ship
name: Introduction and overview — Blue Ridge-class Command Ship — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Blue Ridge-class Command Ship
description: Introduction and overview of the Blue Ridge-class Command Ship: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Blue Ridge class — two ships — are the U.S. Navy's dedicated amphibious command ships (LCC): 19,609 tons packed with communications to command fleet operations. USS Blue Ridge has been forward-deployed to Japan as 7th Fleet flagship since 1979 — one of the longest forward deployments in naval history. Baseline facts: U.S. command ship; 2 built; 19,609 tons; 7th Fleet flagship since 1979..
how_it_works: Buoyancy supports the hull; propellers driven by diesel, turbine, or nuclear plant provide thrust; rudders and thrusters steer; stability comes from hull form and ballast.
